_doc: Pinned toolchain so every machine renders, voices and mixes the same way — the goal is the same style for new films, not byte-identical copies of old ones. setup.sh installs it; doctor.sh checks it.
remotion: 4.0.539 (package-lock.json per film; bundles its own Chrome Headless Shell + FFmpeg for picture and encode)
system_ffmpeg: optional — review contact sheets only; never used for deliverables
